title: Neon Dash
desc: Neon Dash ek fast-paced futuristic offline arcade game hai! Dynamic neon graphics, glowing energy orbs, aur thrilling sci-fi challenges ke saath apna best score banayein.
releaseNotes: Version 1.0.3 (Initial Release): • Full offline gameplay support (Bina internet ke chalne wala) • Smooth one-touch intuitive controls • Futuristic neon graphics aur dynamic visual effects • Interactive home screen dashboard aur custom neon themes • Built-in synthesizer sound effects

title: Zappora Store
desc: Zappora is a fast, lightweight native app store for downloading and installing Android apps and games seamlessly.
releaseNotes: v1.0.2: Initial official release with direct background downloads, native package installer support, and custom branding.

title: Deca chat
desc: Fast, private, and secure group chat app. Create or join custom rooms with a simple room code and connect with up to 20 members without passwords or sign-ups.
releaseNotes: • Initial release (v1.0.1) with real-time messaging and image sharing. • Instant room access with random 6-character room codes (no PIN/passwords needed). • Customizable member limits per room (up to 20 members). • Privacy Shield protection with anti-screenshot blur support. • Quick room renaming and localized device customization.
